scope: Public documented server surfaces inspected 2026-08-29; capability comparison, not provider-wide equivalence

github_async_merge_and_merge_queue.intent_head_precondition: async body sha binds expected PR head; sync merge likewise supports expected head
github_async_merge_and_merge_queue.request_identity: async UUID; 409 may return an existing UUID whose options can differ, so pending details must be compared before adoption
github_async_merge_and_merge_queue.queue_admission_vs_final_effect: enqueued is terminal for async request but only queue admission; final merge outcome must be tracked separately
github_async_merge_and_merge_queue.request_result_retention: 24 hours after most recent async-result update
github_async_merge_and_merge_queue.queue_grouping: stack may be split across consecutive merge groups
github_async_merge_and_merge_queue.post_effect_policy_surface: Rule Suites keyed by ref/before_sha/after_sha with result and evaluation_result; list discovery time_period max month; exact detail by suite ID
github_async_merge_and_merge_queue.strongest_durable_capsule: expected head + async UUID/pending tuple + terminal result + full stack member vector + exact base-ref transition chain + exact Rule Suite IDs/readbacks
github_async_merge_and_merge_queue.known_chat_surface_boundary: current connected GitHub mutation schema exposes sync expected-head merge and auto-merge, not async/stack/queue mutation; direct /stacks read is allowlist-blocked

gitlab_merge_trains.intent_head_precondition: add-to-merge-train accepts sha; if supplied it must match source-branch HEAD
gitlab_merge_trains.request_identity: merge-train entry/car integer id returned with merge request, pipeline, target_branch and status
gitlab_merge_trains.queue_admission_vs_final_effect: complete-scope merge-train entry exposes merged status and merged_at; final repository effect should still be linked through exact merged MR/target-branch evidence rather than treating train pipeline SHA as target tip
gitlab_merge_trains.request_result_retention: inspected Merge Trains API documents active and complete scopes; no GitHub-style 24h result expiry was stated in the inspected contract
gitlab_merge_trains.queue_grouping: REST objects represent one merge request/car, not an entire train; REST has no explicit queue position, sort by id ascending or use GraphQL MergeTrainCar.index
gitlab_merge_trains.post_effect_policy_surface: merge-train pipeline status and merged MR state; MR API exposes merge_commit_sha and squash_commit_sha, but exact target-branch effect remains merge-method-sensitive
gitlab_merge_trains.strongest_durable_capsule: project/MR IID + source head SHA + train-entry id + target branch + train pipeline id/SHA/status + complete-scope train status/merged_at + merged MR commit fields + exact target-branch ref evidence
gitlab_merge_trains.known_chat_surface_boundary: no GitLab connector/action was available in the current connected tool set; pattern is public API evidence for an external handoff, not a directly exercised Chat mutation

comparison.durable_operation_identity: GitLab exposes a server-side merge-train entry id in both active/complete listing contracts; GitHub async exposes a UUID whose result endpoint explicitly expires after 24h. This makes GitLab's documented train-entry identity a stronger recovery anchor in the inspected contracts, but not by itself proof of final target-branch effect.
comparison.final_effect_rule: Neither queue pipeline SHA nor request acceptance is final effect authority. Preserve/verify the target branch's exact landed commit transition after merge.
comparison.retry_rule: Always bind queue admission to expected source/head SHA where the API supports it. After ambiguous responses, search/read existing server operation identity and verify its intent fields before resubmission.
comparison.scope_guard: Do not generalize retention, permissions, policy semantics or connector availability beyond these inspected endpoints and documented fields.
